pain_title: Catechesis should not be scattered across notebooks, spreadsheets, and messages

Family notices get buried across different chats and groups
Documents and certificates arrive through too many channels
It is hard to know what needs attention before the next meeting

faq_subtitle: Direct answers for catechists who want to try it without risk.

faqs.q: Do I need a credit card for the free plan?
faqs.a: No. You create the account and start with Catechist Free without entering a card.

faqs.q: What can I test on the free plan?
faqs.a: Catechist Free includes 1 class, 15 catechumens, digital attendance, integrated Bible and Catechism, and 3 initial AI credits.

faqs.q: When does Catechist AI make sense?
faqs.a: When you want to use AI frequently for meetings, activities, annual planning, family messages, and the theological assistant. The plan includes 20 AI credits per month.
Yes. The platform runs in the mobile browser, including attendance and the main workflows.

faqs.q: Can I import catechumens from my spreadsheet?
faqs.a: Yes. CSV import lets you add catechumens in bulk from the spreadsheet you already use.
The platform includes LGPD-oriented features, digital consent, access control, and data export or deletion requests.
